result.situation: The washing machine doesn't heat water on 60°C cycles. On 23 Feb the landlord replied by email "Yes please arrange an engineer", with no cost cap. Lantern Services was assigned. The visit times on file don't agree: a 23 Feb 3:25pm slot was "confirmed" in a note written after that time had passed, and the tenant's call talks about Tuesday at 1pm. On 26 Feb a system note said there were no work results. On 27 Feb the contractor asked for a callback to schedule the visit. On 28 Feb an invoice email for £75.11 arrived, due 22 July 2026. The invoice document itself isn't visible on the ticket.
